purpose: Rank the smallest exact-stock, carrier, formula-basis, and preparation closures that must precede a concentration-aware binary-mixture experiment.

ranking_policy.rationale: Formula-row counts quantify operational reach, while effort remains categorical because time, reagent, and shipping prices are not governed inputs.

closure_queue.required_evidence: Record exact stock IDs, 1% concentration basis, carrier, preparation or supplier lineage, and label/lot witness.
closure_queue.closure_test: The 1% stock resolves to one ExactStockRef with explicit carrier and fraction basis; the neat parent remains a distinct ExactStockRef.
closure_queue.failure_test: Carrier, fraction basis, parent stock, or stock identity remains unstated or contradictory.

closure_queue.material_scope: Lemonile neat and any 1% working stock
closure_queue.required_evidence: Bind the neat bottle and any claimed 1% in DPG working stock as separate stock IDs with label or preparation receipts.
closure_queue.closure_test: Every prospective dose names exactly one Lemonile stock, strength, carrier, and lineage.
closure_queue.failure_test: The neat material and a working dilution are merged or the dilution is inferred from an unbound note.

closure_queue.required_evidence: Record carrier, parent stock, preparation lineage, and retain v/v as distinct from w/w.
closure_queue.closure_test: The 10% v/v stock has an exact carrier and preparation receipt and is never converted to w/w without density evidence.
closure_queue.failure_test: Carrier remains unknown or v/v and w/w are treated as interchangeable.

closure_queue.required_evidence: Record the 10% carrier and exact stock identifier separately from the neat material.
closure_queue.closure_test: Formula rows bind to an exact neat or 10% stock and the 10% carrier is explicit.
closure_queue.failure_test: A formula names only the material while stock strength or carrier remains ambiguous.

closure_queue.material_scope: Javanol historical neat rows to confirmed 20% in DPG

snapshot_sources.status: DO NOT USE — NEAT STOCK NOT CONFIRMED

closure_queue.required_evidence: Recalculate each held neat-Javanol dose to the confirmed 20% in DPG stock or retain the row on hold.
closure_queue.closure_test: Each affected formula has a reviewed mass-basis equivalence and binds only to the confirmed 20% in DPG stock.
closure_queue.failure_test: Any historical neat amount is executed unchanged or the 20% stock is treated as neat.

closure_queue.material_scope: Alpha Irone 10% gap versus owned 30% w/w in IPM
closure_queue.required_evidence: Review carrier and active-material equivalence before rebasing 10% formula rows to the owned 30% w/w IPM stock.
closure_queue.closure_test: Every rebased row preserves active Alpha Irone mass and explicitly records the IPM carrier contribution.
closure_queue.failure_test: The 30% stock is substituted volumetrically for 10% or carrier effects are ignored.

closure_queue.material_scope: Beta Ionone 1% historical rows versus owned 0.1% stock
closure_queue.required_evidence: Recalculate to the owned 0.1% working stock or deliberately prepare and receipt a distinct 1% stock from the confirmed neat parent.
closure_queue.closure_test: Each row binds to the actual 0.1% stock or a new 1% PreparationReceipt, never to an assumed 1% stock.
closure_queue.failure_test: A 0.1% stock is dosed as 1% or the chosen stock lacks exact identity.

closure_queue.material_scope: Peru Balsam 50% w/w to 10% working stock
closure_queue.required_evidence: Identify the 50% parent carrier, then create a gravimetric 10% PreparationReceipt and recalculate affected rows.
closure_queue.closure_test: The parent carrier and child preparation are exact, and every 10% row binds to the child stock.
closure_queue.failure_test: The parent carrier remains unknown or the 50% product is dosed as a 10% stock.

closure_queue.required_evidence: Create a gravimetric 10% PreparationReceipt from the confirmed neat stock with explicit carrier.
closure_queue.closure_test: A homogeneous 10% child stock has exact parent, carrier, quantities, basis, date, and stock ID.
closure_queue.failure_test: A formula assumes an old 10% stock or the preparation lineage is incomplete.

closure_queue.material_scope: Carrot Seed EO 1% and 10% working stocks
closure_queue.required_evidence: Prepare only the dilution strengths actually needed and receipt each child stock separately from the neat parent.
closure_queue.closure_test: Each 1% or 10% formula row binds to its exact child stock and all carrier contributions remain explicit.
closure_queue.failure_test: Neat Carrot Seed EO is treated as a pre-existing 1% or 10% stock.

closure_queue.required_evidence: Prepare and receipt a 10% in DPG child stock only when needed.
closure_queue.closure_test: The child stock is gravimetrically prepared and every formula names its exact stock ID.
closure_queue.failure_test: A standing 10% stock is assumed without a current receipt.

closure_queue.required_evidence: Prepare and receipt a 1% child stock from the confirmed neat material with explicit carrier.
closure_queue.closure_test: The 1% child stock has exact parent, carrier, fraction basis, quantities, date, and stock ID.
closure_queue.failure_test: A formula assumes a pre-existing 1% stock or omits carrier accounting.

closure_queue.required_evidence: Prepare and receipt a 10% child stock only when required.
closure_queue.closure_test: The exact child stock and carrier are recorded and bound to all affected rows.
closure_queue.failure_test: The listed 10% stock is assumed to exist without preparation evidence.

closure_queue.required_evidence: Prepare and receipt a 10% child stock from the confirmed neat material.
closure_queue.closure_test: All 10% rows bind to a current exact PreparationReceipt.
closure_queue.failure_test: The neat stock is dosed as though it were the historical 10% dilution.

closure_queue.required_evidence: Prepare and receipt a 10% child stock only when required.
closure_queue.closure_test: The 10% child stock is exact and its carrier contribution is preserved.
closure_queue.failure_test: A formula assumes an existing 10% stock from a neat-only holding.

closure_queue.required_evidence: Prepare and receipt a 10% child stock only when required.
closure_queue.closure_test: The exact child stock is recorded before any affected formula is executable.
closure_queue.failure_test: The dilution is inferred from the material name without a stock receipt.

deferred_holds.next_gate: Bind the physical receipt, bottle label, lot, and ExactStockRef before any physical formula use.
Obtain an exact new stock receipt or explicitly design a separately reviewed substitution branch.
Retain as unavailable unless an exact stock is later received and governed.
Do not substitute blood orange, orange peel, or another mandarin without a separate hypothesis and formula review.
Preserve the target identity and require explicit authorization for any substitution branch.

next_hypothesis.question: After exact stock and matrix control, does a nonlinear residual model improve held-out prediction beyond simple component baselines for a bounded binary perfume-material mixture?
minimum_design: ExactStockRef, strength, carrier, and lineage for both components
Fixed substrate, temperature, headspace time, dose basis, and evaluation window
Concentration series with prespecified ratios rather than one arbitrary blend
Blinded randomized repeated sessions with quality, intensity, pleasantness, and component identifiability recorded separately
Prespecified train and held-out split with no post-hoc threshold tuning
next_hypothesis.support_condition: A nonlinear residual model provides a preregistered, repeatable held-out improvement over both simple baselines without relying on stock, carrier, session, or assessor leakage.
next_hypothesis.refutation_condition: The nonlinear model provides no decision-relevant held-out gain, loses the gain across sessions, or only fits concentration or assessor leakage.
stop_conditions: Either component lacks exact stock identity or carrier provenance
Matrix or concentration basis is not controlled
Repeat reliability is below the preregistered minimum
The simple baselines already meet the preregistered prediction target

literature_basis.role: Supports a linear component-average quality baseline; does not establish a universal law.
Supports testing nonlinear intensity prediction only against explicit single-molecule and OAV-style baselines.
Shows mixture outcomes can be source- and pair-specific, so antagonism or addition cannot be assumed universally.
Supports matrix-specific threshold control and rejects transfer of one threshold across substrates.
Supports explicit solvent concentration control because ethanol can materially shift odor thresholds.
Supports separating pleasantness from intensity and using perceived intensity when evaluating binary-mixture pleasantness.

delegation_evidence.cost_attribution_boundary: Exact-project health delta across this bounded wave; not a fabricated per-job token allocation.
